title: Extensions: managing editor packs
description: Toggle editor extensions on or off, reload when prompted, and discover what each pack contributes.

steps.hint: The Extensions tab — every editor pack you've installed lives here. Disable a pack to skip it at load time.
Each row is one pack. Name, version, panel count — and a toggle on the right.
Click a pack's toggle to flip it on or off. Most toggles apply live — panels and commands appear or disappear without a reload.
